key.name: enable-classic-style
key.description: Enforces square buttons, corner integration, and sidebar tinting.

key.name: theme-variant
key.description: Color variant: 'light' or 'dark'.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Selected accent color: blue, teal, green, yellow, orange, red, pink, purple, slate.

key.name: accent-color-automatic
key.description: Automatically pick accent color from current wallpaper.

key.name: opacity
key.description: Opacity level of sidebar in percent (0 - 100, where 0 is opaque and 100 is fully transparent).

key.name: accent-strength
key.description: Intensity of the sidebar tinting with accent color in percent (0 - 100).

key.name: blur
key.description: Window background blur radius in pixels (0 - 50) [beta].

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner rounding for windows and buttons in pixels (0 - 20).

key.name: border-width
key.description: Border thickness of dock and interface frames in pixels (0 - 5).

key.name: control-buttons
key.description: Enables square window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close) [experimental].

key.name: button-size
key.description: Size of square window control buttons in pixels (20 - 48).

key.name: dynamic-panel-maximized
key.description: Adapts the top bar background color to solid black or white when a window is maximized.

key.name: force-icon-shape
key.description: Enforces uniform square icons with accent borders and theme-adaptive background (Adaptive style).

key.name: icon-shape-scale
key.description: Scale percentage of the icon inside the square container (50 - 90%).

key.name: icon-shape-size
key.description: Size of square icon container in pixels (40 - 96).

key.name: icon-border-width
key.description: Border width of the square icon container in pixels (0 - 5).

key.name: icon-squircle-radius
key.description: Corner radius for generated squircle icons in pixels (4 - 36).

key.name: icon-palette-mode
key.description: Palette mode for icon generator: 'accent' (tinted accent), 'colored' (original colors in squircle), or 'adaptive'.

key.name: icon-auto-regen
key.summary: Auto-regenerate icons on accent color change
key.description: Automatically update generated icon theme in the background when system accent or wallpaper changes.

key.name: dock-opacity
key.description: Opacity level of dock/dash in percent (0 - 100, where 0 is opaque and 100 is fully transparent).

key.name: dock-blur
key.description: Dock background blur radius in pixels (0 - 50).

key.name: dock-corner-radius
key.description: Corner rounding for dock/dash in pixels (0 - 35).

key.name: icon-opacity
key.description: Opacity level of square icon container in percent (0 - 100, where 0 is opaque and 100 is fully transparent).

key.name: icon-blur
key.description: Square icon container background blur radius in pixels (0 - 50) [beta].

key.name: firefox-theme
key.description: Automatically deploys square tabs, address bar, and accent color in Mozilla Firefox (userChrome.css).

key.name: chromium-theme
key.description: Enforces system title bar, square frames, and GTK theme in Chrome and Chromium profiles.

key.name: wallpaper-folder
key.description: Path to folder containing wallpapers to load.

key.name: wallpaper-interval
key.description: Interval in minutes to automatically change wallpaper (0 = off, 1, 5, 15, 30, 60).

key.name: wallpaper-change-on-login
key.description: Automatically pick a new wallpaper when logging in.

key.name: wallpaper-current-path
key.description: Path to the currently active wallpaper.

key.name: wallpaper-random
key.description: Whether to randomize wallpaper selection.

key.name: wallpaper-transition
key.description: Enable smooth fade-out and fade-in (dimming and brightening) transition when wallpaper changes.

key.name: prefs-window-width
key.description: Saved width of preferences window.

key.name: prefs-window-height
key.description: Saved height of preferences window.
